# Weak 2 fixture draft (fixture-only synthetic)

## Introduction

This report argues that Inditex can use sustainability to defend its position, and it sets out the drivers and benefits.

## Drivers of sustainability-centric SCM

Regulation and buyer expectations push Inditex to publish targets, and energy costs make waste reduction pay. Lloyd's List reporting shows the fuel rule sits outside the firm.

## Benefits of integrating sustainability

The benefit is a steadier cost per garment where the audited supplier cuts water use.

## Conclusion

Sustainability is important for Inditex and the chain should do more of it.
